versions.content: Allowed operations with boolean variables General Specification of Basic Software Modules AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 46 of 86 Document I D 578 : AUTOSAR_SWS_BSWGeneral The only allowed operations with variables from type boolean are: assignment, return and test for equality, inequality and logical not with TRUE or FALSE .
